labs.name: AECOS Laboratory
labs.detail: DOH microbiology list (as printed): certification type "Full", expires 12/31/26; total coliforms by SM 9221 B MTF MPN, SM 9223 B Colilert P/A, SM 9223 B Colilert QT, SM 9223 B Colilert-18 P/A, SM 9223 B Colilert-18 QT, SM 9223 B Colisure P/A; E. coli by SM 9223 B Colilert P/A, SM 9223 B Colilert QT, SM 9223 B Colilert-18 P/A, SM 9223 B Colilert-18 QT, SM 9223 B Colisure P/A; heterotrophic bacteria by SM 9215 B Pour Plate, SimPlate; fecal coliforms by SM 9221 B+E MTF MPN; enterococci by ASTM D6503-99 Enterolert. Listed as "AECOS, Inc. - Kaneohe, HI". Not on the November 2026 chemistry list.
labs.source_name: Hawaii DOH State Laboratories Division: Drinking Water Microbiology Laboratories Certified by the Hawaii Department of Health (PDF, undated; file created November 18, 2026)
labs.source_name_2: Hawaii DOH Safe Drinking Water Branch: Rainwater Catchment page (last update July 23, 2026) and AECOS Laboratory page (fetched 2026-11-22)
labs.note: AECOS says its lab does "soil, water quality, and drinking water analyses." DOH's previous lab directory (revision November 20, 2025) listed AECOS under "In-state Laboratories (accepts private samples)". DOH's Rainwater Catchment page says DOH subsidizes one lead and copper test per year for homes on rainwater catchment: the owner pays shipping and $25.00, DOH pays the rest, and "AECOS Laboratory, Inc. is currently the only lab approved by DOH, and is participating in this program." AECOS does not post prices for other tests; call for bacteria, nitrate or other tests and ask which ones it is certified for.

labs.name: FQLabs

labs.source_name: Hawaii DOH State Laboratories Division: Drinking Water Microbiology Laboratories Certified by the Hawaii Department of Health (PDF, undated; file created November 18, 2026)
labs.note: DOH lists FQLabs' drinking-water microbiology certification as "Provisional", for one method (Colilert presence/absence). DOH's previous directory (November 20, 2025) listed FQ Labs under "accepts private samples". FQLabs says it offers "microbiological and chemical testing of food, drinking water, wastewater, sludge and soil," lists hours of Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and says customers on the outer islands get sample kits shipped "using airline cargo regularly"; call for shipping instructions. No prices posted.
